interface.shortDescription: Focused coding workflows with Jira and Sentry tools.
interface.longDescription: Soap Toolkit provides concise workflows to plan changes, diagnose bugs, review diffs, simplify code, operate on Jira issues, and retrieve Sentry evidence.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current implementation and plan this change.
Investigate this bug and prove the root cause.
Review the current changes for high-confidence defects.
Simplify the current changes without altering behavior.
Get, comment, transition, or create a subtask for this Jira issue.
Retrieve this Sentry issue and its latest event details.
